01

Opening argument

A representative generated slide with inline deck styles.

02

Problem

Each slide must become a complete thumbnail document.

03

Context

The bridge captures the shared head and an isolated slide clone.

04

Evidence

Editor-only state is removed before capture and save.

05

Approach

The regression fixture remains tracked and deterministic.

06

Workflow

Slide indices stay one-based across the bridge protocol.

07

Details

Inline styles are preserved in the thumbnail srcdoc.

08

Controls

Editable text is wired only in the live document.

09

Quality

Saved HTML must not contain studio scripts or auth tokens.

10

Outcome

The same fixture works on every developer machine and in CI.

11

Close

The deck remains editable, serializable, and portable.
